offerListing.name: Cloud Health Office
offerListing.shortDescription: Azure-native HIPAA-compliant multi-payer EDI integration platform
offerListing.description:
Cloud Health Office is the #1 open-source Azure-native platform for multi-payer EDI integration in healthcare. Deploy a complete HIPAA-compliant EDI solution in minutes, not months.

## Key Capabilities

### EDI Transaction Processing
- **275 Attachments**: Clinical and administrative attachment processing
- **277 RFAI**: Request for Additional Information workflows
- **278 Authorizations**: Prior authorization requests and inquiries
- **837 Claims**: Professional, Institutional, and Dental claims
- **270/271 Eligibility**: Real-time eligibility verification

### FHIR R4 Integration (CMS-0057-F Compliant)
- Patient Access API
- Provider Access API
- Payer-to-Payer API
- Prior Authorization API
- Da Vinci IG support (PDex, PAS, CRD, DTR)

### Zero-Code Payer Onboarding
- Interactive configuration wizard
- Config-to-Workflow generator
- Deploy new payers in under 5 minutes

### Enterprise Security
- Premium Key Vault with HSM-backed keys
- Private endpoints for PHI resources
- PHI masking in logs
- Customer-managed keys (BYOK)
- 7-year data retention

## Deployment Tiers

**Sandbox**: Ideal for development and testing
**Standard**: Production-ready with geo-redundant storage
**Enterprise**: Maximum availability with zone redundancy

## Why Cloud Health Office?

- **Rapid Deployment**: Deploy in <5 minutes with one-click Azure deployment
- **Backend Agnostic**: Integrates with claims adjudication systems such as and other core systems
- **Open Source**: Apache 2.0 licensed, no vendor lock-in
- **CMS-0057-F Ready**: Full compliance with interoperability mandates
- **Cost Effective**: Pay only for what you use with Azure-native pricing

offerListing.gettingStartedInstructions:
## Quick Start

1. Click 'Deploy to Azure' or 'Get it now'
2. Select your Azure subscription and resource group
3. Configure deployment settings (name, region, tier)
4. Click Create and wait for deployment (~5 minutes)
5. Access the Logic App to configure workflows
6. Follow the post-deployment guide to configure trading partners

## Documentation

- [Quick Start Guide](https://github.com/aurelianware/cloudhealthoffice/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md)
- [Deployment Guide](https://github.com/aurelianware/cloudhealthoffice/blob/main/DEPLOYMENT.md)
- [Security Guide](https://github.com/aurelianware/cloudhealthoffice/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
